correctness.rationale: The image of t is nilpotent and therefore has zero constant term, and every such image defines a unital coefficient-field-fixing map. Subtracting the compositions gives the coefficients b(d²−d)+e(a−a²) and h(a−a³)+c(d³−d)+2be(d−a). Reversing the convention for map composition reverses the signs but not their common zero set. If a−a² and a−a³ are both nonzero there is exactly one (e,h) per d. At a=0,1, characteristic two leaves d unrestricted if b=c=0 and allows just 0,1 otherwise; both e,h are free. In odd characteristic the pure cubic if nonzero allows d=0,1,−1 and free e,h, while nonzero b permits only 0,1 with e free at d=a and zero at the other d. At a=−1 in odd characteristic, e=bd(d−1)/2, leaving (c+b²)d(d−1)(d+1)=0 and unrestricted h. This gives every displayed stratum and its multiplicity with no primality assumption on q. When q=2 the first two rows merge at q³; when q=3 the nonzero pure cubics merge with the q³ row, and the two a=−1 rows merge at 9. The center formula follows, and summing the row products gives the two pair-count polynomials with total population q³. In characteristic two the compositions of t+t² and t+t³ modulo t⁵ differ in t⁴, so the binary commutativity boundary is genuine. Independently implemented Horner composition exhaustively checked the complete prime-field histograms for q=2,3,5,7 and replayed the length-five counterexample.
residual_risks: The F₄ test is package-recorded evidence. Extension-field validity follows from the symbolic field calculation, not extrapolation of the independent prime-field checks.

value.rationale: Centralizer sizes are natural element statistics of this full substitution monoid, including maps outside any unit group. Cubic order is where both the characteristic-dependent factor of two and the additional multiplier resonance at −1 enter. The exhaustive all-field table quantifies these effects, explains the two exceptional centers, and provides an exact benchmark for investigations at longer length. The binary counterexample marks a genuine boundary, not a value claim based on a single recomputed small field.
residual_risks: No higher-length centralizer spectrum or arbitrary ring-endomorphism classification is claimed for the frozen finding.
